whatsNew: Fixed the Android shell status-bar overlap so the website starts below the phone system bar.
Adjusted the desktop WebView scale to make buttons and text easier to read without making the layout too large.
Strengthened the in-app updater and validates the downloaded APK before handing it to Android.
Future APK releases continue using the persistent signing key so in-place updates can preserve app data.
App-local account and WebView storage remain separate from Chrome browser data.
